name: How can I improve the security of my existing sliding door, even after replacing the lock?

mainEntity.name: How can I improve the security of my existing sliding door, even after replacing the lock?

acceptedAnswer.text: Beyond replacing the lock, you can enhance sliding door security with several measures. Consider adding a security bar or a track lock that prevents the door from being forced open or lifted off its track. Installing a secondary lock, such as a foot lock or a key-operated bolt, provides an extra layer of protection. Alarm sensors or glass break detectors can also deter intruders. These additions work in conjunction with a robust primary lock to create a more secure entry point.
acceptedAnswer.description: Improve sliding door security by adding a security bar, track lock, secondary bolt locks, or alarm sensors, in addition to a new primary lock.
